text:
taylor: quick heads-up — i'm swapping to @jamal for overnight coverage. leaving a short pass on the postmortem items from INV-2026. main things left: cache invalidation fix (staged), the db index backfill (in progress), and alert threshold tuning (+ dashboard update). please see notes below. :memo:

jamal: thanks — taking it. can you drop the exact PRs and the current staging link? i want to run a quick smoke before bed. :coffee:

maria: PRs are: #4238 (cache fix), #4242 (index backfill), #4250 (alert tuning). staging deploy is at https://staging.redwood-inference.internal. smoke tests passed once after deploy but i saw one flaky 504 at 10:12pm. logs attached in thread. :mag:

alex: tagging rollback policy: if we see >5% error rate or p50 latency >200ms across the frontend route, we rollback to tagged commit `release-2026-04-12`. no manual DB rollback needed for backfill, it's additive.

patrick: FYI i repro'd the cache-stale symptom in staging with a short key TTL scenario. snippet from staging logs:

```n
2026-03-16T22:12:03Z INFO cache:get key=prompt-prefix-12 hit=false
2026-03-16T22:12:03Z WARN kv-load latency=312ms
2026-03-16T22:12:03Z ERROR inference:response-mismatch request_id=abc123
```n
pattern looks like missing prefix invalidation on partial model rollout. i opened #4261 with repro steps. :bug:

maria: @patrick thanks — i reran the smoke suite with the repro payloads. results: 10/10 prompt-prefix tests passed after i applied the cache header change in #4238. however the long-seq path still has occasional 502s (2/30).

jamal: i'll validate #4238 in staging now and promote to dedicated if green. quick smoke command i'm running (feel free to copy):

```n
curl -X POST "https://staging.redwood-inference.internal/v1/generate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $STAGING_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-v1","input":"prefix test"}'
```n

sre-bot: deployment: pr-4238 merged and deployed to staging by maria at 2026-03-16T22:30:12Z. status: partial (service-group: model-cache) - monitoring alerts off by default for staging.

taylor: for handoff checklist: 1) jamal owns rollout + monitor update, 2) maria will finish backfill verification in the morning, 3) alex will sign off on threshold values, 4) if any client errors >5% escalate to eng-sre and page oncall. leaving the runbook link: https://confluence.redwood/inference/INV-2026-runbook. :link:

jamal: noted. i'll tweak the alert to `inference.errors.percent > 4.5` for the next 2 hours while we watch, then revert to 2.5 after stabilization. i'll post metrics before i step off.

patrick: small ask — if we see the 502s continue, consider reopening the postmortem ticket; current fix seems partial. i can help investigate the long-seq codepath with a deeper capture.

maria: agreed. i'll capture full request/response pairs for the long-seq path and drop them to the postmortem doc. also starting the index backfill job now; ETA ~3h.

alex: ping me if you need the dedicated capacity bumped for the backfill window (we can enable burst for the job). also i've left a note in the rollout PR about adding a changelog entry for the alert delta.

taylor: thanks team — i'll check in at 05:30 UTC. jamal, you're primary. escalate if anything suspicious. :thumbsup:

jamal: taking over. monitoring alert updated, running extended smoke for 30m. will post final pass before 05:30 UTC. :eyes:
